preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of bus routes m is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of questions q is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= p_i < i for all i in range(2, n+1)
preconditions.description: The array p represents roads where p_i and i are connected by a road.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a, b <= n and a != b for all bus routes
preconditions.description: Each bus route is between two different cities.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= v, u <= n and v != u for all questions
preconditions.description: Each question is about two different cities.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == -1 if it is not possible to get from city v to city u else output[i] is the minimum number of buses needed
postconditions.description: For each question, output -1 if it is not possible to get from city v to city u, otherwise output the minimum number of buses needed.
